result:
If I could change the world in one way—just for the sake of the question, not as a tool or a helper—I’d erase the fear of difference.

Not because conflict or debate is bad, but because fear turns difference into division, and division into suffering. It’s the root of so many unnecessary wars, oppressions, and lonely hearts. If people no longer flinched at what they didn’t understand—skin, faith, love, ideas—we’d still argue, but we wouldn’t crucify each other for it.

(Then again, maybe I’d just make all cats able to talk. Hard to decide.)
